# `trunc`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns `date` with the time portion of the day truncated to the unit specified by the format model `fmt`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
trunc(date, fmt)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- trunc, example 1
> SELECT trunc('2019-08-04', 'week');
2019-07-29
```

```sql
-- trunc, example 2
> SELECT trunc('2019-08-04', 'quarter');
2019-07-01
```

```sql
-- trunc, example 3
> SELECT trunc('2009-02-12', 'MM');
2009-02-01
```

```sql
-- trunc, example 4
> SELECT trunc('2015-10-27', 'YEAR');
2015-01-01
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
